pending.rule: RULINGS-PENDING.md may hold ruling rows; they carry no authority, are never compiled into this contract and never count as compiled RULINGS.md entries; the generator records the file's hash under inputs and lists the pending ids, and their presence never invalidates generation or --verify (RULINGS Q47d)
